<thought>I need to determine how many aromatic carbon atoms are in the unknown sample. The best way is to obtain its 13C NMR spectrum and count the signals that fall in the typical aromatic region (≈110–160 ppm). This will give the number of distinct aromatic carbon environments, which corresponds to the number of aromatic carbons in the molecule.</thought>
